title: Mnesis Canonical Extension Registry
description: Schema for extensions/registry.json — the public list of non-standard frame keys that producers carry today. Authority: SPEC.md §Extensions (issue #69, root-cause card for Parthenon#47). Registering is deliberately a one-repo PR with no cross-repo coordination: the cost of declaring an extension MUST stay below the cost of hiding it, or producers keep shipping invisible fields and canonical finds out last.

extensions.description: One entry per registered extension key. Sorted by name.

name.description: The frame key exactly as it appears on the wire. NEW registrations MUST use the reserved namespace 'x-<vendor>.<field>' (e.g. 'x-iris.hand_left_kpts3d'). Unprefixed names exist only for pre-standard fields registered retroactively.

owner_repo.description: The repository that produces the field, e.g. 'Mnesis-Labs/Mnesis-Iris'. Whoever writes the key owns the entry.

since.description: Registration date (YYYY-MM-DD). For retroactive entries this is the date the field was registered, not the date it first shipped — see notes.

description.description: What the field carries, in enough detail for another repo to decide whether it needs the same thing.

promotion_status.description: 'active' = in production, no promotion requested. 'proposed' = the owner is asking for it to become a standard field. 'promoted' = it became a standard field; 'replaced_by' names it and the extension is on its deprecation window. 'withdrawn' = no longer produced.

replaced_by.description: The standard field this extension was promoted to. null when the field was promoted by being DROPPED (e.g. a derived projection that belongs to an exporter). Required in spirit when promotion_status = 'promoted'.

reference.description: Issue / PR / spec link with the reasoning, e.g. 'Mnesis-Labs/mnesis-canonical#68'.

notes.description: Anything a consumer needs that does not fit above — e.g. when the field actually first shipped.
